description: Generic IMAP/SMTP email connector (Tier-4 EMAIL class). Indexes the user's mailbox over raw IMAP as `imap:email` items — message HEADERS (subject, from, to/cc, date, message-id), a short capped plain-text body PREVIEW (~2 KB / 2000 chars), and attachment METADATA only (filename, size, mimetype). It NEVER downloads or parses attachment bytes and never fetches the full message body: it uses the IMAP ENVELOPE + BODYSTRUCTURE for headers and attachment metadata, and fetches only a truncated text/plain body part for the preview. Read tools (`imap_list`, `imap_get`, `imap_search`) plus one HITL-gated write tool (`imap_mail_send`) that sends mail over SMTP via nodemailer. IMAP/SMTP credentials are per-tenant (host, port, username, password) and arrive as scoped environment variables injected at spawn time (IMAP_HOST/IMAP_PORT/IMAP_USERNAME/IMAP_PASSWORD and IMAP_SMTP_*) — the connector never reads the vault. Because the IMAP/SMTP hosts are user-configured and non-443 (IMAP 993, SMTP 465/587), the static manifest network list is intentionally empty: the concrete <imap.host>:993 + <smtp.host>:<port> host:port entries are added to the sandbox network allow-list at spawn time by phase3AddImapMcp via manifestWithExtraNetworkHosts.
